decisions.reason: Placing the INA219 after the Schottky diodes does not change the standalone regulator, source-selection behavior, activation condition, or powered load.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the board chain and the main board's local and downstream power distribution; no additional update or removal is required.
The source changes INA219 placement and coverage on the 3.3V rail, not the independently switched 5V rail.
The sensor board remains supplied from the 3.3V rail as already specified; measuring its downstream current does not change its module interfaces.
The source does not change the AXP2101 battery or USB path or its role as the normal-operation 3.3V source.
The BOOT and reset circuitry is only an incidental downstream load and remains unchanged.
Identifying the ESP32 as part of the monitored downstream load does not change the selected module or breakout requirement.
The 3.3V current-monitor location does not change USB enumeration or programming behavior.
The source does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
The source discusses the monitored 3.3V ESP32 and sensor-board load and does not change the separate LED board.
The addressable LEDs use the separate 5V supply and level-shifted data path, neither of which is changed by the 3.3V INA219 placement.
The source does not address or resolve the battery connector's series, mounting, or unresolved pinout.
